description: This Java class defines the entity 'SavingsOfficerAssignmentHistory' which tracks the history of savings officers assigned to savings accounts, including start and end dates, and handles audit timestamps.

classes.name: SavingsOfficerAssignmentHistory
classes.description: Entity class representing the history of savings officer assignments to savings accounts, including start/end dates and audit info.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Factory method to create a new assignment history record with a start date.

methods.name: setSavingsOfficer
methods.description: Sets the savings officer for this assignment record.

methods.name: isSameSavingsOfficer
methods.description: Checks if the provided staff is the same as the assigned savings officer.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the assignment.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the assignment.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the assignment.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the assignment.

methods.name: matchesStartDateOf
methods.description: Checks if the given date matches the start date.

methods.name: isBeforeStartDate
methods.description: Checks if the given date is before the start date.

methods.name: isBeforeEndDate
methods.description: Checks if the given date is before the end date.

methods.name: isCurrentRecord
methods.description: Determines if this record is the current active assignment (end date is null).

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp, maintaining backward compatibility.

methods.name: getLastModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns the last modified timestamp, maintaining backward compatibility.
